findings.highlight: let others know of my weakness
findings.evidenceJa: 敵に弱点を見抜かれる
findings.governingReading: have an enemy discern my weakness
findings.explanation: Saber’s tactical admission to an enemy becomes a general concern about other people.

findings.evidenceJa: 風格も十分
findings.governingReading: your bearing has all the dignity required
findings.explanation: Rin’s appraisal of Saber’s commanding presence becomes a judgment of her personality.

findings.evidenceJa: へっぽこ
findings.governingReading: incompetent hack
findings.explanation: Rin insults Shirou’s practical competence, not his intelligence.

findings.highlight: shows no openings, just like a devil
findings.evidenceJa: 鬼みたいに容赦がない
findings.governingReading: is as merciless as a demon
findings.explanation: Issei’s warning about Rin’s lack of mercy is replaced by combat-style impenetrability.

findings.highlight: Servants can adapt to any time
findings.evidenceJa: 人間の世であるのなら、あらゆる時代に適応します
findings.governingReading: As long as it is the human world, Servants adapt to every era
findings.explanation: The domain limiting Saber’s broad temporal adaptation is removed.

findings.highlight: You lack experience as a Master
findings.evidenceJa: マスターとして知識がなさすぎる
findings.governingReading: you know far too little as a Master
findings.explanation: Saber criticizes Shirou’s missing knowledge, not his lack of practical experience.

findings.highlight: I want you to become stronger
findings.evidenceJa: 強くなってもらわなければ困ります
findings.governingReading: I need you to become stronger
findings.explanation: Saber’s contractual necessity and concern are softened into personal preference.

findings.highlight: it carries a fear that it might collapse
findings.evidenceJa: 作りが頑丈でないというか
findings.governingReading: its construction does not seem very sturdy, raising the fear that it might collapse
findings.explanation: The perceived physical reason for Shirou’s anxiety is omitted.

findings.highlight: The suburbs are the oldest of all
findings.evidenceJa: 郊外はその中でも最たるものだ
findings.governingReading: The outskirts are the foremost example of that old townscape
findings.explanation: A claim that the outskirts best preserve the traditional streets becomes a chronological superlative.

findings.evidenceJa: なだらかに続く坂道
findings.governingReading: a gently continuing slope
findings.explanation: The geography becomes malformed and less precise.

findings.evidenceJa: 十字架らしき物
findings.governingReading: what looks like a cross
findings.explanation: The first distant religious landmark is replaced by a generic building.

findings.highlight: visit God’s house for the first time
findings.evidenceJa: 今まで寄りつきもしなかった神の家
findings.governingReading: the house of God I had never even gone near
findings.explanation: Shirou’s longstanding avoidance of the church is reduced to lack of a prior visit.

findings.highlight: must cover the whole top of the hill
findings.evidenceJa: 高台のほとんどを敷地にしているのか
findings.governingReading: seems to occupy most of the high ground
findings.explanation: The church grounds’ estimated extent is exaggerated from most to all.

findings.highlight: you should not go any farther
findings.evidenceJa: これ以上遠くには行かないでしょう
findings.governingReading: you will not be going any farther than this
findings.explanation: Saber’s factual inference from the church being the destination becomes advice or prohibition.

findings.evidenceJa: これだけの席があるという事は
findings.governingReading: The presence of this many seats suggests
findings.explanation: Shirou’s concrete evidence for estimating attendance is replaced by overall size.

findings.evidenceJa: よほどの人格者
findings.governingReading: a man of exceptional character
findings.explanation: Shirou’s premature moral inference about Kirei becomes social distinction.

findings.highlight: miracles are only given to holy saints
findings.evidenceJa: 奇跡は選ばれた聖人だけが学ぶもの
findings.governingReading: miracles are arts only chosen saints may learn
findings.explanation: The Church’s restriction on learning miracles becomes passive divine allocation.

findings.highlight: the more divine protection one receives, the more one should stay away from magic
findings.evidenceJa: 神の加護が厚ければ厚いほど魔術とは遠ざかっていく
findings.governingReading: the greater the divine protection one enjoys, the further one grows from magecraft
findings.explanation: The English sentence is syntactically broken and changes an inherent inverse relation into advice.

findings.evidenceJa: こっち側の人
findings.governingReading: a person on the occult side
findings.explanation: Shirou asks whether Kirei belongs to the hidden supernatural world, not whether he shares their faction.

findings.evidenceJa: 決まりだったわよね
findings.governingReading: that was the rule
findings.explanation: A number mismatch produces malformed English.

findings.evidenceJa: 最後までここには訪れなかったろう
findings.governingReading: she would never have come here, even at the very end
findings.explanation: Kirei’s absolute prediction about Rin’s continued avoidance is weakened.

findings.evidenceJa: 気が乗らない素振りで神父を促す
findings.governingReading: Rin prompts the priest with obvious reluctance
findings.explanation: Rin’s reluctance to hand the conversation to Kirei disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: くくく、と愉快そうに笑う
findings.governingReading: Father Kotomine chuckles in evident delight
findings.explanation: Kirei’s enjoyment and Shirou’s mounting anxiety through the exchange are flattened.

findings.highlight: everything will be as you desire
findings.evidenceJa: 何もかもが元通りだぞ
findings.governingReading: everything can be restored to the way it was
findings.explanation: Restoration of the prior state becomes fulfillment of unspecified desire.

findings.highlight: Your wishes, even cleaning out all the mud inside of you, is possible
findings.evidenceJa: その裡に溜まった泥を全て掻き出す事もできる
findings.governingReading: Even all the mud accumulated within you can be dredged out
findings.explanation: The sentence is grammatically broken and obscures Kirei’s invasive metaphor.

findings.highlight: soak into my brain and clot like blood
findings.evidenceJa: 胸に浸透して、どろりと、血のように粘り付く
findings.governingReading: seep into my chest and cling there, thick and viscous like blood
findings.explanation: The bodily location and image of Kirei’s words penetrating and adhering are substantially changed.

findings.highlight: compassion is not good for others
findings.evidenceJa: 情けは人の為ならず
findings.governingReading: kindness to others ultimately benefits oneself
findings.explanation: The proverb is rendered as its common false opposite immediately before Kirei explicitly explains the correct meaning.

findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯聖杯って繰り返してる
findings.governingReading: You keep repeating “Holy Grail”
findings.explanation: Shirou’s demand to define the object is misquoted as repetition of the war’s name.

findings.highlight: A Holy Grail that makes wishes comes true
findings.evidenceJa: 望みを叶える聖なる杯
findings.governingReading: a holy cup that grants wishes
findings.explanation: Subject–verb agreement visibly breaks a central definition.

findings.evidenceJa: 実在したとも、再現できたとも聞かない
findings.governingReading: has never been heard to exist or to have been reproduced
findings.explanation: Lack of attestation becomes categorical impossibility and nonexistence.

findings.evidenceJa: この奇蹟は魔法と言える
findings.governingReading: this miracle may be called true Magic
findings.explanation: Kirei’s classification is weakened from qualifying as Magic to merely approaching sorcery.

findings.evidenceJa: 物の真贋
findings.governingReading: whether the object is genuine or false
findings.explanation: The question of authenticity becomes an assertion of unreality.

findings.highlight: the ritual where those chosen by the Holy Grail slay each other
findings.evidenceJa: 殺し合う降霊儀式
findings.governingReading: a spirit-invocation ritual in which those chosen by the Grail kill one another
findings.explanation: The occult type of ritual is omitted.

findings.highlight: you can form a contract with Servants
findings.evidenceJa: 幾らでもサーヴァントと契約できる
findings.governingReading: you may contract with Servants any number of times
findings.explanation: The extent of a marked Master’s re-contracting right is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: マスターを失ったサーヴァント
findings.governingReading: Servants who have lost their Masters
findings.explanation: All forms of Master loss are narrowed to death.

findings.evidenceJa: 監督役として最優先事項
findings.governingReading: my highest priority as supervisor
findings.explanation: Kirei’s stated first priority becomes one major responsibility among several.

findings.highlight: the lowest of the special agencies
findings.evidenceJa: 特務局の末端
findings.governingReading: an outpost at the edge of the special bureau
findings.explanation: An outlying church unit within a bureau becomes the lowest-ranked agency among several.

findings.evidenceJa: 慇懃な仕草でおかしそうに笑った
findings.governingReading: Kotomine Kirei laughs with amused, elaborately courteous manners
findings.explanation: The formal courtesy that sharpens Kirei’s mockery disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: あの地獄が、脳裏に浮かんだ
findings.governingReading: that image of hell flashes
findings.explanation: A stray capital after a comma visibly breaks the sentence.

findings.evidenceJa: 体が崩れ落ちる
findings.governingReading: My body starts to collapse
findings.explanation: Shirou’s near-collapse is weakened to a stumble.

findings.evidenceJa: 完成には至らなかった
findings.governingReading: never reached completion
findings.explanation: An unfinished Grail becomes a completed but flawed one, changing a central state distinction.

findings.evidenceJa: 甘ちゃんだった
findings.governingReading: was a naive softheart
findings.explanation: Rin condemns the prior Master’s sentimentality, not cowardice.

findings.highlight: The priest requests my final decision
findings.evidenceJa: 高みから見下ろして
findings.governingReading: Looking down from on high, the priest demands my final decision
findings.explanation: The physical staging that embodies Kirei’s authority disappears.

findings.highlight: whether to prepare for it or not
findings.evidenceJa: 心構えが出来ていたかいないか
findings.governingReading: whether one’s mental readiness was already in place
findings.explanation: A preexisting state of readiness becomes a voluntary preparatory choice.

findings.highlight: I approve the battle in this town
findings.evidenceJa: この街における魔術戦を許可する
findings.governingReading: I authorize magical warfare in this city
findings.explanation: Kirei’s formal authorization loses its occult scope.

findings.evidenceJa: おそらく君が勝者になるだろう
findings.governingReading: You will probably be the victor
findings.explanation: Kirei’s confident prediction is weakened to bare possibility.

findings.evidenceJa: 兄弟子
findings.governingReading: senior fellow disciple
findings.explanation: Kirei’s seniority within the shared teacher relationship disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 足は勝手に後ずさる
findings.governingReading: my feet retreat on their own
findings.explanation: Shirou’s body recoiling independently becomes deliberate movement.

findings.evidenceJa: 目の前が、真っ暗になりそう、だった
findings.governingReading: it felt as though everything before his eyes was about to go black
findings.explanation: An impending physical or psychological blackout becomes an already completed visual change.

findings.evidenceJa: 目指す理想が矛盾しているだけの話
findings.governingReading: the ideal he is striving toward is simply contradictory
findings.explanation: A single pursued ideal is fractured into plural “target ideals,” producing malformed English and blurring Shirou’s specific contradiction.

findings.highlight: Your worries are normal for a human being
findings.evidenceJa: 君の葛藤は、人間としてとても正しい
findings.governingReading: your inner conflict is entirely proper for a human being
findings.explanation: Kirei’s validation of Shirou’s moral conflict is weakened into generic worries and ordinary normality.

findings.evidenceJa: 愉しげに笑みをこぼす神父
findings.governingReading: the priest lets a delighted smile spill across his face
findings.explanation: Kirei’s pleasure in exposing Shirou’s contradiction disappears, flattening his provocation and cruelty.

findings.highlight: You are now at the point of kill or be killed
findings.evidenceJa: 君は殺し、殺される側の人間になった
findings.governingReading: you have become one of those who kill and are killed
findings.explanation: A lasting change in Shirou’s human position is reduced to a generic immediate dilemma.
